findings.evidence: Basic.lean:393 `@[expose, simps n center dom]` (ofBaseSet), :434 (append), :505 `@[expose, simps n center]` (focus); :542 `simp only [focus]`.
findings.fix: Add `dom` to `simps`, or add the `focus_dom_self : (A.focus i hL hLi).dom i = A.dom i` and `focus_dom_of_ne (hj : j ≠ i) : … = A.dom j \ L` lemmas, and prove `focus_dom_subset`/`focus_dom_inter` from them.
findings.issue: `focus` uses `@[simps n center]` but not `dom`, unlike `ofBaseSet`/`append` (`@[simps n center dom]`, lines 393/434). As a result, `focus_dom_subset`/`focus_dom_inter` use `simp only [focus]` to unfold the body. No `focus_dom_self`/`focus_dom_of_ne` lemma exists.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:409-424 `@[simp] chart_ofBaseSet … rfl`, :487-495 `@[simp] coord_append_*`; ExtensionByZero.lean `halfCoord_focus` ends with `rfl`, and `halfImage_focus_le` uses `simpa only [chart, focus_center]`.
findings.fix: In the `Focus` section, add `@[simp] theorem chart_focus (j) : (A.focus i hL hLi).chart j = A.chart j`, `triv_focus` and `@[simp] coord_focus : (A.focus i hL hLi).coord j = A.coord j`, each proved by `(rfl)`. Then derive `halfCoord_focus` from `coord_focus`.
findings.issue: The parallel atlas constructions have `@[simp] chart_ofBaseSet`, `coord_append_castAdd` and `triv_append_*`, but `focus` has no `chart_focus`, `triv_focus` or `coord_focus`. So `halfCoord_focus` closes with a bare `rfl` that depends on the definition's internals, and `halfImage_focus_le`/`halfCoord_focus_eq_zero` rely on `simpa only [chart, focus_center]` to unfold `chart`.

findings.evidence: In `exists_chartValueL_ae_eq_halfCoord_of_eq_zero`: `rw [show A'.halfCoord j s = A.halfCoord j s from halfCoord_focus hL hLi j s] at hcoord`.
findings.issue: `halfCoord_focus` is a normal-form readback (the focused atlas has the same readings) but is not marked `@[simp]`. Consumers have to apply it by hand with `rw [show … from halfCoord_focus …]`.

summary: The new `FiniteBundleAtlas.focus` lacks its characterizing API: no `dom` projection and no `chart`/`triv`/`coord` lemmas, so consumers unfold the exposed body or rely on `rfl`. The readback lemmas are also not marked `@[simp]`.
